title: Tech Note: New 4D v6.5 Picture Library Animation Feature

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a genuinely new 4D v6.5 feature: built-in Picture Library animation support that let developers add animated graphics to forms without any plug-in, a modest but notable enhancement to the classic Picture Library subsystem. The specific Picture Library animation mechanism described here is tied to the classic Design-Mode-era forms engine and 4D v6.5's picture handling, and while animated form graphics remain achievable in modern 4D (through updated picture/animation properties or web-based UI), the exact feature and workflow described is now a legacy technique superseded by newer graphics and UI options.
related_updates: 4D's forms and picture-handling engine has evolved substantially since v6.5, including modern picture object properties and, for many use cases, web-based UI where animation is handled via standard web technologies
The specific Picture Library animation workflow from 4D v6.5 is a legacy technique rather than the current recommended approach for animated UI content
